Mrs. Fisher: That Walleye you caught was a monster.
You: Thanks.
Mrs. Fisher: I’m glad I gave you that rod. Now you are a full fledged fisher.
Mrs. Fisher: If you ever get on a boat, try trolling. It’s a good technique for catching predatory fish.
You: Trolling?
Mrs. Fisher: It’s a technique in which you slowly keep pulling the lure through the water behind a moving boat.
Mrs. Fisher: Just remember to wait till the lure hits the bottom. It takes some patience, but it will make sure that the fish notices the lure.
